title: Tampere Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Tampere Cathedral medium-fi exterior:rough grey/warm stone asymmetrical church,west rose/gabled portal and red tiled cross roofs; tall southwest,middle northwest and small northeast tapering spires with green tips;pointed belfry louvers,large south rose/gable and lower pointed lights,round west stair turret,southeast sacristy;two mapped gabled pedestrian gatehouses and bounded picture-led low red-capped wall wings. Shared textures and four browser LODs. Trees,park paths,full enclosure/interiors,glass artwork and exact terrain joins excluded or approximate.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Exact retained way/88874701 and Q1236638 match current whole 35184460963533 and its same-ID multilingual Tampere Cathedral/Tampereen tuomiokirkko POI. All eight selected whole/part/gatehouse controls and their raw points/properties remain source inputs, alongside the earlier 23-point whole outline. Anchor and heading0.150597742317 rad are unchanged. The tall southwest tower, lower northwest tower and west rose/portal in inspected photographs sign the -X front; the south transverse gable and third northeast spire agree with the plan. No horizontal rescale.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: The retained whole and Wikidata height64 m disagree with the current southwest tower part68 m. Preserve both;use the current68 m part as the approximate tall-spire envelope without claiming a survey. Other current parts supply northwest52 m, northeast36 m, body28 m and southeast20 m envelopes. Interpret body28 m as the main/transverse roof ridge with estimated eaves17.5 m; tall/middle/small tower masonry42/30/19 m and their roof partitions are picture estimates. Southeast part20 m controls a low sacristy gable; gatehouse5 m tags control approximate gables over3.7 m walls. Floor0.4 m,round front turrets,porches,window/door/louver splits,low wall wings and part datums are estimates. No precise surveyed doorway,height or engineering claim.

Medium-fi exterior from three inspected2017/2007/2012 pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. Current tower68 m part and retained whole64 m height conflict;both preserved,not independently resolved. Hidden roof/gable joins and lower-window/porch/enclosure divisions remain picture estimates. Glass art,fine stone details,complete park enclosure/paths/trees,interiors/bells and engineering excluded or simplified. Current finish,exact host-ground joins,absolute altitude and physical-device timing unverified.

Skyline keeps three unequal spires,west/south rose gables,irregular red roofs,portal,round turret and two gate tunnels. District adds shared surfaces,front/side light rhythm,louver groups and roof bands. Street adds recessed apertures,lead-grid abstraction,trim and buttress caps. Closeup/master refine louver/lead spacing and sparse roof ribs. Regional Finnish log cabins are fixtures.
importReason: Preserve individual rough-stone west/south rose gables,three unequal red tapering spires with green tips,pointed louver panels,projecting portal/round turret,mapped sacristy and two gabled gatehouses in four browser levels.
